caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object composed of several figures and elements. At the center right, there is a lion with a prominent mane, standing on a flat, irregularly shaped base. The lion is positioned with its mouth open, facing upwards and to the left. The lion is mostly brown with hints of yellow and orange, and its eyes are red and black. To the left side of the drawing, a tree stump extends diagonally from the base, and on top of this stump is a monkey-like figure with a humanoid appearance. The monkey is brown in color and is reaching out with its left arm towards the lion, holding a small round object in its hand. Its tail curls around the trunk. The tree stump and the surrounding base feature textures and colors that suggest moss or foliage, with patches of green, yellow, and orange. There are additional forms on the base that resemble rocks or plants. The background is a light beige color with no other objects or features.
title: Toy Bank
